name: FileUpload
description: A drop zone and button for choosing files, with type, size and count limits and a list of the chosen files you can remove from. The component picks the files; you upload them.

label.description: What the files are for, e.g. "Attachments". It names the control.

accept.description: Allowed types: MIME types like "image/png" or "image/*", or extensions like ".pdf". Others are rejected with a message.

maxSize.description: Largest file in bytes. Bigger files are rejected.

onChange.description: Called with the full list of files whenever it changes.

onReject.description: Called with files that were refused, and why. The component also lists them.

browseLabel.description: Text of the button that opens the file picker.

keyboard: Tab reaches the Browse files button; Enter or Space opens the file picker
Tab reaches each Remove button; Enter or Space removes that file
requirements: Dragging is an extra: everything can be done with the Browse files button and the keyboard
The group is named by its label and described by the description
Each Remove button names its file (Remove report.pdf)
Adding, removing and rejecting files are announced in a polite live region
Rejected files and the reason are written out, not only coloured
The drag-over highlight is also a change of text, not only of color
screenReader: The group is announced with its label and description
Adding files announces how many were added, e.g. "2 files added"
A rejected file is announced with its name and reason, e.g. "photo.tiff not added: file type not allowed"

use_when: When people may have the files on their desktop to drag in
avoid_when: Uploading as a background process with progress: pair it with Progress and your own queue
Picking one value from a list
anti_patterns: A drop zone with no button
Limits that are only discovered after upload
Trusting accept or maxSize alone: check files on the server too
